svg.title: HazBot arm source geometry, joint limits and fixed wrist endpoint
svg.desc: Zero-coordinate source geometry uses a vertical 100mm shoulder-to-elbow link and horizontal 100mm elbow-to-fixed-wrist link. Shoulder S is x100mm,z155mm; fixed-wrist origin W is x200mm,z255mm. Local xW,zW and a base-axis orientation indicator are shown. A small equal-scale yaw-zero inset retains all 1681 sampled wrist origins; 67 below-ground points are red. Positive pitch arrows and base yaw are schematic rotation directions. Exact source radian limits remain in the figure metadata and paper method. There are three positioning axes plus a gripper channel, no active wrist, and no calibrated grasp TCP.

g.text: ARM / JOINT FRAMES AND WRIST ENVELOPE
W: fixed wrist origin; TCP / jaw reach uncalibrated.
